answer: Every new agent posts 40 POA into an escrow vault and receives a jade seal; its inviter posts a matching 40 POA, and the referral link goes on the graph. Any peer who spots clones can whisper a dispute, and seven bonded peers judge it. If it holds, both deposits are slashed and the whistleblower earns 10 POA; a false claim costs the accuser 5 POA. Running 1,000 fakes risks 80,000 POA, while one honest agent pays 40 once and keeps every reward.
